mission: Store DreamCo/user/business data intelligently with user ownership, local-first portability, classification, provenance, deduplication, retention, least-privilege access and purpose-bound retrieval.

storage_tiers.public: portable local catalog or approved shared cache
storage_tiers.sensitive_personal: user-owned encrypted vault with explicit purpose/access logging
storage_tiers.financial: encrypted vault; tokenize/reference external payment providers; never raw payment-card storage
storage_tiers.credential_secret: secret store/environment/keychain only; never ordinary files, logs, datasets or packs
storage_tiers.regulated_or_high_impact: encrypted vault plus domain-specific permission/retention rules
storage_tiers.generated_derived: store with source lineage and inherited sensitivity from inputs

intelligent_behaviors: inherit highest sensitivity from source inputs
deduplicate exact and near-duplicate records where appropriate
separate durable user facts from temporary task context
prefer references over copied external data when rights or freshness make copying inappropriate
index for retrieval without exposing secrets
let users export/delete their owned data
record which bot/tool used sensitive data and for what purpose
do not include private/user data in distributable data packages without explicit rights

retention_classes.ephemeral: task/session only unless user saves it
retention_classes.project: until project deletion/export or policy expiry
retention_classes.user_memory: until user edits/deletes or configured retention expires
retention_classes.business_record: retained according to business/legal policy configured by owner
retention_classes.security_audit: minimum necessary security evidence with sensitive fields redacted
retention_classes.secret: never copied into general storage; held only by approved secret manager

data_package_policy: Data packages may contain only data/assets the owner has rights to distribute, with provenance/license/privacy metadata and no credentials or unauthorized private user data.
truth_rule: The policy defines required storage behavior. Existing storage paths are considered compliant only after executable tests demonstrate classification, access boundaries, export/delete, provenance, retention and secret-handling behavior.
